03 / HOW I THINKTHE WORK BENEATH THE SURFACE↘

Good systems.
Clear intentions.

The interesting part begins when the pieces need to agree. These are the questions I keep coming back to.

01Make the rules visible.↗

What can change? Who owns it? Where should a decision live? I start with boundaries that make the behavior understandable.

DOMAIN / RESPONSIBILITY / INTENT
02Let the evidence speak.↗

Retries, stale state, stock, money. The difficult cases belong in the checks. AI can help with the work; verification has the final word.

TESTS / AUDIT / CONSISTENCY
03Keep room for curiosity.↗

Take things apart. Build a smaller version. Learn why they work. A personal setup is as much a place to experiment as a place to focus.

EXPERIMENT / SIMPLIFY / REPEAT
